description: Part 2 of a 3-part series on data centers, AI, and Georgia's future. Georgia's data center tax incentives are projected to cost billions more than originally estimated. As data center development accelerates across the state, an important question deserves greater attention: Who is paying for this
paid_for_by: Paid for by Michelle For Georgia House** Photography: Kevin Lowery and Tara Gulledge
title: Data Centers: Who Pays for the Tax Breaks? — Michelle Schreiner is a candidate for Georgia House District 45, rooted in East Cobb and focused on steady leadership, practical solutions, and real progress for Georgia families.
